# Conduct

> Agent governance, policy enforcement, and activity records. Coverage depends on the configured integration and enforcement surface.

## Public resources
- [Documentation](https://conductai.ai/docs)
- [MCP setup](https://conductai.ai/docs?tab=mcp-tools)
- [Deployment](https://conductai.ai/deployment)
- [Playbook registry](https://conductai.ai/registry)
- [Source](https://github.com/sseshachala/conductai)
- [CLI](https://pypi.org/project/conduct-cli/)
- [Trial installer](https://conductai.ai/install): download and inspect before execution.

## Authentication boundary
The installer requires curl, Python 3, an interactive terminal, and email verification. It is not unattended anonymous provisioning.
The dashboard and conduct login require browser authorization. Automation requires workspace-scoped credentials from an authorized administrator. Never publish credentials in logs or issues.
Configure MCP clients with https://api.conductai.ai/guard/mcp and authorize workspace access. There is no public .well-known/mcp.json server catalog.
